reviews.comment: **ENGL 342** LOVED Prof DiCaglio!! She is so so caring and very practical. Her lectures are amazing and so low pressure. Graded on very few things, but she gives you time and lots of help on these assignments. Attendance and participation matter lots and also help you a lot on the assignments.

I took her Barbie Senior Seminar class and it was the highlight of my Spring Semester. She is by far one of my favorite professors here at Texas A&M. SOOO much that I have decided to do a directed study under her next semester. She's kind, thoughtful, and cares for all of her students to succeed in class and also in the future. 110% recommend!!!

Such an amazing and funny professor. There's a bigger learning curve than I've ever had in an English class, but that's because she pushes you to truly grow in your writing. Once you've done that, everything gets a lot easier. She really helped me improve, and I would suggest taking her if you genuinely want to be a better writer. Also very caring!

Take Dr. D! She is the most understanding professor ever! Attendance is mandatory, but she is very understanding if you have excusable absences; if you participate in class, your grade will not suffer. She expects students to dig deep in their writing and to go outside of their comfort zone. She is a wonderful teacher! I highly recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Take Dr. DiCaglio! Truly an amazing professor that really cares about her students. You'll read about 5 books over the semester and write a short essay (500 words) about most of them. She is very caring and is absolutely willing to work with your schedule if you need it. A great person and would definitely take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DR. DICAGLIO IS AN ABSOLUTE SWEETHEART!! She makes it clear that she cares and supports you finding success. She is extremely understanding, and often makes accommodations to help you! Beware though, not all professors will be as nice!

Dr. DiCaglio is an amazing professor! She is understanding and cares about her students. She has great energy when teaching and makes learning fun. There are some required reading but they're extremely interesting and not boring at all. Overall a great professor that I would take again!

Amazing professor who genuinely cares about her students learning and success. She is very considerate of student issues and maintains an approachable nature. The course is easily accessible with almost everything needed being already provided. Overall I wish I could have taken more classes from her sooner!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I can not express how amazing this woman is as a person and a professor!! She is super sweet and really cares about her students success. She is willing to work with you if youre struggling which is so helpful. If you can take this professor as she is my favorite I have had in college so far. Teaching style, class, environment is out of this world.

She is such a caring professor who is very intuned to what her students can handle and how to help them. She gives amazing feedback and is chiefly concerned with her students well being and making them better writers. You read lots of books, but as someone who hates them her books were amazing. Take her, shes the best prof Ive had as an engl major
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Dicaglio is one of the best profs I've ever had. During the pandemic, she was very understanding about having different levels of energy and motivation and adjusted accordingly. She legitimately wants her students to learn and grow and you can really tell that in the way she teaches. Would highly recommend!

Dr. DiCaglio likes to give a lot of short papers that are easy to write. The only difficulty was the course reading, but that makes sense given the nature of the class. She's such a kind and caring professor, always ready to make accommodations for her students, and is clearly beyond passionate about what she does. She's funny and great! :)
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor DiCaglio was an amazing professor, she truly cares about the subject she's teaching about and she cares about her students. She is a bit of a tough grader, but I went and talked to her before my essays were due and she helped me immensely and I ended up getting a much better grade on my essays!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. DiCaglio is the absolute best professor I've had in college and I plan on taking as many of her classes as I can. She loves to help students and is very accessible outside of class. She grades fairly (a little on the easier side) and gives great feedback. She makes all of her classes fun and genuinely wants students to succeed.

Dr. DiCaglio is the best professor I've taken at A&M. She is very passionate about teaching and about her students. She helped my writing improve tremendously and gives incredibly helpful feedback on papers and other assignments. Her class and reading list was super interesting, and she genuinely cares about her student's success.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Awesome online class!! Loved it!! 10/10 recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: DiCaglio is so encouraging & welcomes new ideas/theories on writing. I loved this class! She helped me move from the 5 paragraph form of writing to new/interesting ways to write effectively and persuasively. She also cares a lot about her students & is willing to take the time to understand how each individual learns to better her teaching.

Nice, clear, organized prof. Pretty time consuming class. No tests, but major assignments due as well as discussion board posts due twice a week every week. I was not a fan of the research project we had to do, which was a huge portion of this class. She grades pretty fair though. As long as you turn in quality work on time, you should get an A.

This class is online, so be disciplined in checking eCampus for assignments. Class participation in forum posts is critical to your grade - do them on time! Go to office hours to meet with the professor to make the class feel less impersonal. Be aware: Dr. DiCaglio is the course designer, so she knows what she's doing. Take this class seriously!
Mrs. DiCaglio is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She gives amazing feedback and is one of the best explainers I have ever seen.
